plugin.manualDescription: Identifies the selected comics on Comic Vine, sending every one to the manual review (whatever the settings say).
plugin.autoDescription: Identifies the selected comics on Comic Vine and tags the sure ones automatically (whatever the settings say).
settings.askBeforeStart: Ask every time before starting: automatic or manual (when off, it starts with the mode below)

{0} book(s) selected. How do you want to start?

Automatic: the books that are sure are tagged by themselves and the rest go to the manual review.
Manual: every book goes to the manual review, with the search results and their match percentage.

ai.title: Research with AI
ai.intro: Write here what you already know about this comic: notes, links to a wiki or the publisher's page, or text copied from there. Claude reads the links and the cover, and fills in what its sources say (identification, creators, dates, summary...). You will see everything and can correct it before it is sent. Leave it empty to use only the cover.
ai.introChrome: Write here what you already know about this comic: notes, links to a wiki or the publisher's page, or text copied from there. Claude reads the links (in Chrome if it cannot read them directly) and the cover, and fills in what its sources say (identification, creators, dates, summary...). You will see everything and can correct it before it is sent. Leave it empty to use only the cover.
edit.dateHint: Year-month-day (2022-05-07), or only 2022 or 2022-05. Empty adds nothing.
edit.dateInvalid: The date "{0}" is not valid. Use year-month-day (2022-05-07), or only the year or the year and month.
edit.webInvalid: The web page has to be an address that starts with http:// or https://.
settings.aiChrome: The research with AI may open a link in Chrome (Claude in Chrome) when Claude cannot read it directly
